description: Multi-hue product system: six product families each own a saturated hue used on cards and actions.
forbiddenFeatureTags: neutral palette with a single accent

referenceProfile.thesis: Color is the navigation system: each product family owns one saturated hue that appears on its card, its action, and nowhere else.
signatureMoves: A six-tile category grid assigns each product a distinct saturated hue with white type on top.
Actions invert the scheme: white buttons with the family hue for text.
transferPreserve: Keep one hue per product family and use it consistently for that family's surfaces and actions.
transferAvoid: Do not blend hues within a tile or add neutral cards that break the color-as-identity system.
